title: Association of peptidyl prolyl cis/trans isomerase Rrd1 with C terminal domain of RNA polymerase II.
authors: Kashif, Mohd; Kumar, Bhupendra; Bharati, Akhilendra Pratap; Altayeb, Hisham; Asalam, Mohd; Akhtar, Mohd Sohail; Khan, Mohammad Imran; Ahmad, Abrar; Chaudhary, Hani; Hosawi, Salman Bakr; Zamzami, Mazin A; Baothman, Othman A
one_liner_zh: 该文通过荧光各向异性、pull-down和MD模拟研究Rrd1与RNA聚合酶II CTD的蛋白-DNA互作，聚焦磷酸化状态对结合亲和力的影响，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但MD方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合机制研究。
abstract: The largest subunit of RNAPII extends as the conserved unstructured heptapeptide consensus repeats Y(1)S(2)P(3)T(4)S(5)P(6)S(7) and their posttranslational modification, especially the phosphorylation state at Ser2, Ser5 and Ser7 of CTD recruits different transcription factors involved in transcription. In the current study, fluorescence anisotropy, pull down assay and molecular dynamics simulation studies employed to conclude that peptidyl-prolyl cis/trans-isomerase Rrd1 has strong affinity for unphosphorylated CTD rather than phosphorylated CTD for mRNA transcription. Rrd1 preferentially interacts with unphosphorylated GST-CTD in comparison to hyperphosphorylated GST-CTD in vitro. Fluorescence anisotropy revealed that recombinant Rrd1 prefers to bind unphosphorylated CTD peptide in comparison to phosphorylated CTD peptide. In computational studies, the RMSD of Rrd1-unphosphorylated CTD complex was greater than the RMSD of Rrd1-pCTD complex. During 50 ns MD simulation run Rrd1-pCTD complex get dissociated twice viz. 20 ns to 30 ns and 40 ns to 50 ns, while Rrd1-unpCTD complex remain stable throughout the process. Additionally, the Rrd1-unphosphorylated CTD complexes acquire comparatively higher number of H-bonds, water bridges and hydrophobic interactions occupancy than Rrd1-pCTD complex, concludes that the Rrd1 interacts more strongly with the unphosphorylated CTD than the pCTD.
abstract_zh: RNAPII最大亚基延伸为保守的无序七肽重复序列Y(1)S(2)P(3)T(4)S(5)P(6)S(7)，其翻译后修饰，尤其是CTD在Ser2、Ser5和Ser7位点的磷酸化状态，招募参与转录的不同转录因子。在本研究中，通过荧光各向异性、pull down实验和分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟研究，得出结论：肽基脯氨酰顺反异构酶Rrd1对未磷酸化CTD具有强亲和力，而非磷酸化CTD，以促进mRNA转录。在体外，Rrd1优先与未磷酸化的GST-CTD相互作用，而非高度磷酸化的GST-CTD。荧光各向异性显示，重组Rrd1倾向于结合未磷酸化的CTD肽，而非磷酸化的CTD肽。在计算研究中，Rrd1-未磷酸化CTD复合物的RMSD大于Rrd1-pCTD复合物的RMSD。在50 ns的MD模拟运行中，Rrd1-pCTD复合物两次解离，即20 ns至30 ns和40 ns至50 ns，而Rrd1-unpCTD复合物在整个过程中保持稳定。此外，Rrd1-未磷酸化CTD复合物相比Rrd1-pCTD复合物，获得相对更多的氢键、水桥和疏水相互作用占有率，从而得出结论：Rrd1与未磷酸化CTD的相互作用强于与pCTD的相互作用。
